Iran is a country where history is literally etched into every stone. In the heart of ancient Persia stands Isfahan, a city that has inspired poets and travelers for centuries. Its majestic squares, graceful emirs' palaces, and ancient mosques create an atmosphere as if time has stood still. Narrow streets lead to bustling bazaars, where artisans continue centuries-old traditions: carpets, ceramics, and embossing—all crafted by hand, just as they were hundreds of years ago.

But Iran is more than just architecture and history. It is a land of contrasts, where nature amazes with its scale and diversity. The endless Lut Desert—one of the hottest places on the planet—reveals a different, almost otherworldly beauty. Oases emerge from the sands and rocks like mirages, offering life and coolness.
